description: Return the x402 payment challenge (v1 JSON body plus, when the server sends it, the decoded v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header as paymentRequired) for purchasing a public product. This wraps the existing public /p/:id-or-slug flow and does not require owner credentials.

clientReferenceId.description: Optional client reference ID forwarded to the purchase flow

metadata.description: Optional metadata object forwarded to the purchase flow

productIdOrSlug.description: Product slug or product ID used in the public /p/:id-or-slug purchase route

name: request_product_purchase_payment
